item_name: Rothco NIJ Approved Stainless Steel Hinged Handcuffs

The hinged design offers enhanced control and security compared to traditional chain handcuffs, making them ideal for high-risk situations. description: Rothco’s NIJ Approved Stainless Steel Hinged Handcuffs provide unparalleled security and reliability for law enforcement and security professionals. Crafted from durable stainless steel, these handcuffs are designed to meet the rigorous NIJ Standard 0307.01, ensuring they perform to the highest standards. The hinged design offers enhanced control and security compared to traditional chain handcuffs, making them ideal for high-risk situations. These police handcuffs feature a double lock mechanism, preventing over-tightening and providing additional security once the cuffs are locked. Each pair comes with 2 keys, ensuring you always have a backup. The sleek stainless steel finish not only adds to their durability but also gives them a professional appearance. Whether you are in law enforcement, security, or another field requiring reliable restraints, Rothco’s Stainless Steel Hinged Handcuffs are the ideal choice.
